title.zh: 将南拉瑙省马拉维市—卡帕伊—塔戈洛安第二公路（经邦戈洛波布拉西翁、卡帕伊与塔戈洛安第二）更名为Ahmad Domocao Alangadi Alonto Sr.参议员国家公路的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Marawi City-Kapai-Tagoloan II Lanao Del Sur Road, Stretching From Barangay Banggolo Poblacion in the City of Marawi, and Traversing Through the Municipalities of Kapai and Tagoloan II, All in the Province of Lanao Del Sur, as Senator Ahmad Domocao Alangadi Alonto Sr. National Road
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Marawi City-Kapai-Tagoloan II Lanao Del Sur Road, Stretching From Barangay Banggolo Poblacion in the City of Marawi, and Traversing Through the Municipalities of Kapai and Tagoloan II, All in the Province of Lanao Del Sur, as Senator Ahmad Domocao Alangadi Alonto Sr. National Road

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2022/ra_11798_2022.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Marawi City-Kapai-Tagoloan II Lanao del Sur Road, stretching from Barangay Banggolo Poblacion in the City of Marawi, and traversing through the Municipalities of Kapai and Tagoloan II, all in the Province of Lanao del Sur, is hereby renamed as Senator Ahmad Domocao Alangadi Alonto Sr. National Road.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders, and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act within sixty (60) days from its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
